title: PERCIVAL: RNA-seq analysis code for the tomato leaf transcriptome dataset
description:
Scripts and commands used for the RNA-seq bioinformatic analyses and figure generation of the Scientific Data descriptor Multi-omics analyses of tomato rhizosphere and leaves treated with a biowaste-derived biostimulant extract (Bona et al., Fondazione Edmund Mach).

Contents:

  • Preprocessing and alignment — SLURM batch scripts as executed, with every tool inside an Apptainer image: FastQC 0.12.1, fastp 0.23.4, STAR 2.7.11b against Solanum lycopersicum SL5.0 with the ITAG5.0 annotation, samtools 1.22.1, and featureCounts 2.1.1 (-p -s 2 --countReadPairs -t exon -g Parent).
  • Technical validation — read retention through the pipeline, and a blind variance-stabilising transformation with a sample-to-sample Euclidean distance heatmap, plus the supplementary QC table and supporting QC panels.
  • Variance decomposition — Bioconductor variancePartition applied under the model ~ trial * time point + condition with sum-to-zero contrasts, quantifying the contributions of experimental trial, sampling time point and treatment per gene and per principal component, with a moderated F-test per model term.
  • Figure assembly — composition of the descriptor's Figure 2 from the panels the analysis scripts write.

The analysis is reproducible end to end: no absolute path appears in the R code, and run_all.sh regenerates every figure and table from the deposited count matrix. Analysis outputs are included alongside the code so they can be checked without an R installation.

The data are deposited separately: count matrices, physiology, soil and leaf chemistry on Zenodo (10.5281/zenodo.19336336) and raw sequencing reads at NCBI SRA (BioProject PRJNA1425279).
